opening_question: Namaste. Aaj aap kya taklif le kar aaye hain? Thoda detail me bataiye.

mandatory_slots.question: Ye dard kab se shuru hua? Achanak hua tha ya dheere-dheere badha?
Dard seene mein exactly kahan ho raha hai? Beech mein, left side, ya right?
Dard kaisa hai? Jalan jaisa, dabaav jaisa, ya chubhan jaisa?
Ek baar dard hota hai to kitni der rehta hai?
Kya ye dard kahin aur bhi jaata hai — jaise baayein haath, jabda, ya peeth mein?
Kis cheez se dard badhta hai? Chalne se, saans lene se, ya khaana khaane se?
Kis se aaram milta hai? Aaraam karne se ya koi dawai lene se?
1 se 10 ke beech, dard kitna tez hai? 10 sabse zyada.

screening_questions.question: Dard ke saath pasina aata hai ya ghabrahat hoti hai?
Saans lene mein takleef hoti hai?
Ulti jaisa ya matli mehsoos hoti hai?

background_slots.question: Pehle kabhi BP, sugar, ya heart ki koi problem rahi hai?
Abhi koi dawai chal rahi hai?
Ghar mein kisi ko heart attack ya heart ki bimari rahi hai?
Aap tambaku ya cigarette lete hain?
